category.build.name: Build
category.build-advanced.name: Advanced Build
category.hero.skills.name: Abilities
category.hero.skills.description: Learn or improve the hero's abilities. The number shows unspent skill points.
command.attack.name: Attack
command.attack.description: Attack-move on ground, or force attack a visible damageable target, including friendlies.
command.build.name: Build
command.build.description: Place a construction project on explored, clear ground.
command.cancel.name: Cancel construction
command.cancel.description: Cancel this project and refund its reserved resources to an owned Mound with space.
command.cancelResearch.name: Cancel research
command.cancelResearch.description: Cancel this research and refund its full price.
command.cancelUpgrade.name: Cancel upgrade
command.cancelUpgrade.description: Cancel the upgrade and refund the full price.
command.follow.name: Follow
command.follow.description: Follow a friendly unit. Right-click a friendly unit to follow it.
command.garrison.name: Enter watchtower
command.garrison.description: Walk to a friendly watchtower and occupy its single lookout.
command.hold.name: Hold Position
command.hold.description: Stand your ground. Attack enemies within weapon range without chasing.
command.move.name: Move
command.move.description: Move eligible selected units to a destination.
command.patrol.name: Patrol
command.patrol.description: Patrol between the current position and a destination. Engage enemies, then resume patrol.
command.pause.name: Pause production
command.pause.description: Finish committed work, then release staffing. Resume to request work again.
command.produce.name: Produce
command.produce.description: Train a unit. Reserves its resources and supply immediately.
command.rally.name: Rally point
command.rally.description: Choose where newly produced units assemble.
command.research.name: Research
command.stop.name: Stop
command.stop.description: Cancel orders and return to autonomous activity. Carried goods remain physical.
command.unload.name: Leave watchtower
command.unload.description: Release the archer at the tower entrance. A move order also leaves the lookout.
command.upgrade.name: Upgrade building
navigation.back.name: Back
navigation.back.description: Return to the previous command category.
navigation.camera.name: Cycle camera
navigation.camera.description: Follow the selected unit. Cycle RTS, third person and first person. Escape returns to RTS.
